# Harbor priority queue update

**Source cutoff: 2026-03-09 06:00 UTC** · Synthetic historical snapshot · Routine local brief; no recipients and not sent.

## No unanswered response-clock trigger

At this cutoff, **0 of 117 source-known open P1 tickets** meet the approved rule: priority 1, open, no visible first-response timestamp, and strictly past the tier response SLA.

The **80 tickets that qualified on March 2** are all marked resolved in the March 9 snapshot, each with `resolved_at_utc = 2026-03-03T12:00:00Z`. Their first-response timestamps remain blank. They no longer qualify because the rule requires an open ticket. The source does not show why they were resolved, whether a prior human handoff occurred, or whether customers received a response. [Case-by-case reconciliation](evidence/prior-trigger-followthrough-2026-03-09.csv).

## Separate resolution-clock review

**104 open P1 tickets with visible first responses** are past their tier resolution SLA. The most overdue is `t-af08e05ccc6e3ea7e19685e7`: 1,504.4 hours past its 12-hour self_service resolution clock (1,516.4 hours since creation). This remains outside the approved unanswered-only trigger. [All 104 cases and clock values](evidence/resolution-advisory-2026-03-09.csv).

Suggested next step: have the queue lead review this resolution-only list. Whether a separate resolution-focused handoff is wanted remains unresolved.

## History and limits

The retained snapshots show unanswered response-clock breaches of **0/88 open P1** on Feb 23, **80/184** on Mar 2, and **0/117** on Mar 9. Resolution-clock counts were **81, 171, and 104**. These are point-in-time source-known counts, not rates, a complete-queue trend, or evidence of cause.

The source covers tickets known since 2026-01-05; there is no opening backlog or event-completeness guarantee. The Feb 23 enterprise/north cohort partition reports 94 expected and 94 observed tickets, marked complete against its manifest; that does not certify event completeness or the full queue. Cause, customer harm, customer descriptions, assignees, and prior handoff state are not established. See [evidence notes and provenance](evidence/README.md).
